title: Account Advocacy Feedback Loop and Roadmap Consolidator
creator: Maya Singh
description:
Problem:
Teams receive high-touch requests from top accounts via multiple channels (AE, CSM, legal escalations, support tickets, account execs). Signals are inconsistent, duplicate, and surface at different times. This causes: unclear commitment windows, engineering context gaps, ad-hoc prioritization by senior stakeholders, and overloaded delivery lanes.

Goal:
Design a repeatable 'Account Advocacy Feedback Loop' — a lightweight intake and consolidation layer that surfaces canonical account asks, aligns them with OKRs and engineering capacity, and produces a prioritized roadmap delta with clear commitment windows and fallback SLAs. The system should: canonicalize signals, score asks by business impact & implementation cost, produce a 30/60/90 day commitment view, and generate a triage outcome for Eng/Design.

Proposal / Components:
1) Intake consolidator: a short form + webhook collectors (CSM form, AE Slack slash command, support escalation template) that populates a canonical ticket in our intake queue (Confluence intake page + internal datastore).
2) Signal fusion & scoring: algorithmic score using account tier, ARR at risk, renewal timing, number of customers requesting feature, technical effort estimate (T-shirt), legal/compliance risk. Score outputs: AdvocateScore (0-100) and UrgencyTier (Critical/High/Medium/Low).
3) Commitment windows: per-item 30/60/90 day view with three outcomes: Committed (scope & timeline), Scoped for next cycle (no firm date), and No-Commit (documented fallback + compensating measures).
4) Roadmap consolidator dashboard: single view in Redwood Console for PM/GTMs with links to original requests, AdvocateScore, current status, and recommended engineering lane. Integrate with Roadmap OKR tags.
5) Escalation guardrails: SLA triggers for items that hit AdvocateScore > 80 and renewal window < 90 days; automatic escalation to VP Product with summary packet.

Acceptance criteria:
- Intake consolidator accepts three channels and creates canonical intake tickets automatically 95% of the time.
- Signal fusion ranking correlates with historical escalations in a sanity check sample (n=40) with Spearman rho >= 0.6.
- Dashboard exposes 30/60/90 commitment view and per-account backlog export.
- Playbook documented and published in Confluence with step-by-step triage for PM/CSM/Eng.

Success metrics (first 90 days after launch):
- Reduction in duplicate escalations by 40%.
- Time-to-decision for top-account asks reduced from median 18 days to 7 days.
- 85% of Committed items meet their published 30/60 day window or have documented rollback plan.

Rollout plan:
- Week 1-2: prototype intake form + Slack command; run with 3 CSM volunteers.
- Week 3-4: build scoring lambda and dashboard read-only prototype; gather feedback from GTM.
- Week 5-6: integrate canary with product roadmap UI, add export and SLA triggers.
- Week 7: company-wide launch to CSM/AE; training doc and office hours.

Open questions / trade-offs:
- How prescriptive should scoring be vs PM judgement? Proposed: use score as advisory with mandatory manual override & audit trail.
- Where to store canonical tickets long-term (Confluence vs internal datastore)? Proposal: Confluence for playbook + short summary, canonical records in internal Airtable-like datastore for queries and exports.
- Data privacy: requests may include PII (customer screenshots). Ensure KMS encryption at rest and redact in exports.

Risks:
- Over-triage leading to inflated backlog and political pressure. Mitigation: explicit capacity banding and commitment windows.
- GTM bypassing the system for fast escalation. Mitigation: make intake friction lower than bypass path and add escalation visibility.

Dependencies:
- Eng: API endpoints for intake webhook and roadmap tagging (ENG-28412).
- Console: dashboard embed slot and permission controls (ENG-29100).
- Legal: template for redacted customer artifacts (Legal-78).

Artifacts & links:
- Confluence PRD (draft): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PM/pages/Acct-Advocacy-Feedback-Loop
- Intake prototype Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/advocacy-intake-prototype
- Scoring algorithm notebook (internal gist): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcX
- Roadmap consolidator mock in Console: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/advocacy

Notes: This ticket focuses on the consolidation and triage layer. Implementation work for persistent datastore and Console embedding will be tracked as ENG sub-issues after initial scope alignment.
